notes: Actual results for the fiscal year ended June 30, 2024, as the city reported them to the Census Bureau's Annual Survey of State and Local Government Finances. Not a budget.
Public schools are run by separate school districts with their own taxes, so they are not included. Residents also pay Floyd County.
Covers every fund, including water, sewer, electric and other utilities. Debt service counts interest and principal repaid; borrowing and transfers between funds are left out.
Debt service leaves out $2,390,000 of principal repaid with new borrowing the city did not spend on capital that year, most likely refinancing or a rolled-over note.
Courts, legal services, public buildings, housing and community development count as overhead.
Debt is long-term debt outstanding plus short-term debt at year end.
Political money is not scored: contributions to Iowa city candidates were not loaded.
Transparency practices have not been checked yet, so they are not scored.
Cameras: no license-plate cameras are mapped inside City of Charles City's borders in OpenStreetMap as of 2026-10-18.

Most records carry no dollar amount, so each documented program costs a quarter of the red-flag points instead of being counted as spending.
